text:
Situation: Ifosfamide injection is on FDA's shortage list as Current with an initial posting date of 2026-06-12 and updates through 2026-10-16. The shortage covers products from Baxter Healthcare, Fresenius Kabi USA LLC, Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc., and SteriMax Inc. Corvale East holds 9 vials of 50 mg/mL 60 mL presentation at 3.5 vials per day, giving 2.6 days on hand. Corvale Lakeside holds 19 vials of the same presentation at 0.7 vials per day, giving 26.5 days on hand. Corvale General holds 41 vials of 50 mg/mL and 42 vials of 1 g/20 mL, each providing over 14 days. Corvale Lakeside also holds 9 vials of 1 g/20 mL at 13.8 days.

Why (FDA record): FDA's shortage list shows ifosfamide injection as Current since 2026-06-12 with updates through 2026-10-16. No FDA inspection classification or public signal is recorded for the plants supplying our Corvale sites.

Our position: Corvale East is critically low on the 50 mg/mL 60 mL presentation. Corvale Lakeside has sufficient supply to support a transfer while maintaining adequate stock. Alternate concentration options are approved and available.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 8 vials of ifosfamide 50 mg/mL 60 mL from Corvale Lakeside to Corvale East — requires pharmacy director approval of the transfer request.
2. Use Hikma's ifosfamide 50 mg/mL alternate concentration — requires pharmacist verification for dose and volume recalculation; approved by Riley Brooks, PharmD on 2026-09-15.
3. Use Baxter's ifosfamide 1 g/20 mL alternate concentration — requires pharmacist verification for dose and volume recalculation; approved by Riley Brooks, PharmD on 2026-04-18.

Not recommended: No additional actions at this time.
